native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 1, 'state': {'led1': 'off', 'led2': 'off', 'servo1': '0 degrees'}, 'description': 'Initialization phase. After power-on or reset, both LEDs are off and the servo motor is at 0 degrees.'}

test2: {'time': 4.5, 'state': {'led1': 'on', 'led2': 'off', 'servo1': '180 degrees'}, 'description': 'Clockwise movement phase. After moving the potentiometer to maximum (value 1), the servo moves clockwise to 180 degrees, and LED1 lights up while LED2 remains off.'}

test3: {'time': 8, 'state': {'led1': 'off', 'led2': 'on', 'servo1': '0 degrees'}, 'description': 'Counterclockwise movement phase. After moving the potentiometer back to minimum (value 0), the servo moves counterclockwise to 0 degrees, and LED2 lights up while LED1 remains off.'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
